briefings.tldr: The "Byzantine Empire" is an artificial historical misnomer for what was legally, culturally, and politically the unbroken continuation of the Roman Empire, which survived for over a millennium in the East due to its unique "monarchic republic" structure, robust fiscal institutions, and resilient Roman-Orthodox identity.
